rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an identifying characteristic, including an inherited or acquired feature.

example.english: The most obvious trait of this butterfly is the red spots on its wings.
example.traditional: 呢種蝴蝶最明顯嘅特徵係對翼有幾粒紅點。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 wu4 dip2 zeoi3 ming4 hin2 ge3 dak6 zing1 hai6 deoi3 jik6 jau5 gei2 nap1 hung4 dim2

rows.note: Use this for an enduring personal quality or personality trait rather than an observable feature.

example.english: Patience is an important trait for a teacher.
example.traditional: 耐心係做老師好重要嘅特質。
example.jyutping: noi6 sam1 hai6 zou6 lou5 si1 hou2 zung6 jiu3 ge3 dak6 zat1

rows.note: Use this when the trait is specifically a recurring tendency or behavioral trend.

example.english: They have a trait of putting things off until the last minute.
example.traditional: 佢有拖到最後一分鐘先做嘢嘅傾向。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 to1 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 fan1 zung1 sin1 zou6 je5 ge3 king1 hoeng3
